About Me

Building mobile apps, one clean screen at a time.

I’m a third-year Computer Science student specializing in Software Engineering at Ahram Canadian University (ACU). My focus is mobile development with Flutter & Dart, and I also have programming experience with C#, C++, and Python. I work on responsive interfaces, state management, REST API integration, and local storage with SQLite & Hive. I love solving algorithmic challenges and turning Figma designs into working apps.
